selected.working_title: Android CLI packages device workflows as reusable agent skills
Copilot metrics expose a hidden failure mode in agent telemetry
Claude Frontier Academy targets the forward-deployed engineering skills gap
Ambient agents turn events into resumable human-approved workflows
AgentCore gives Claude Desktop a governed web-search path

rationale.m01: The only evidence-qualified reusable Agent Skills candidate and a concrete maintained workflow for packaging device operations as agent skills.
rationale.m02: A current reliability issue with direct operational implications: agent activity can disappear from usage telemetry after an SDK migration.
rationale.m08: A distinct knowledge-worker capability story focused on developing forward-deployed engineering skills rather than product usage alone.
rationale.m09: Concrete enterprise adoption evidence at meaningful scale, with explicit company-reported usage figures and limitations preserved.
rationale.m15: A detailed event-driven agent architecture with isolated sessions, human approval and resumable interruption semantics.
rationale.m16: A distinct governed-agent pattern for adding authenticated web search to Claude Desktop through JWT and IAM controls.
